news.title: AI Revival Lifts Stocks as Bonds Fall on Election Day – US Market Wrap
news.description: A revival in the AI trade powered Wall Street gains, while bonds fell and the dollar rose on US Election Day. Chipmakers halted a decline fueled by concerns that the AI spending boom is becoming harder to justify. The rebound lifted the S&P 500 even as most of its companies fell. Meta Platforms attracted solid demand for its first bond deal in six months. Oil prices eased in a volatile session, but the decline was not enough to lift Treasuries amid solid job openings data.
